headline: Chip Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch

writeup.headline: Chip Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Hot CPI, Waller Floats Half-Point Hike for December. The big swing: chip stocks rallied early, then turned around after 10:01 AM and are now lower on the day — Coinpaper points to “Wells Fargo Turns Less Bearish on AI Stocks After 38% Semiconductor Crash”. The AI names are flat and the average stock is down: stocks are moving together. Defensive sectors are leading cyclical ones, and the S&P has stayed under pressure.

themes.headline: Chip stocks flipped from up to down
themes.detail: Up 1.0% at 10:01 AM, now -2.5%; hardest hit since: Advanced Micro Devices, Broadcom. In the news: “Wells Fargo Turns Less Bearish on AI Stocks After 38% Semiconductor Crash” (Coinpaper).

themes.headline: S&P has stayed under pressure
themes.detail: Low at 11:56 AM, high at 10:01 AM; -0.4% since the open.
